title: Pitch from IMU data
line: A Kalman filter on a drifting gyro and a noisy accelerometer.
description: Pitch attitude from flight-test IMU data: a gyro that drifts and an accelerometer that is noisy, combined with a two-state Kalman filter.
thumbnailAlt: Pitch from accelerometer tilt, gyro integration and a Kalman estimate against the reference, rendered by RunMat
